MPhil/PhD
Join our vibrant research community and learn from leading researchers
Photo by op23 on Unsplash
{:.info-box}
Current HDR students with questions about their program can email: hdr.css@anu.edu.au.
Our highly-ranked research program features world-renowned faculty,
interdisciplinary research, and a spirit of collaboration. Both the
Master of Philosophy and Doctor of Philosophy are advanced research
training programs supervised by our leading researchers.
